name: valve_ep2_bunker_door
note: White Forest's round blast door (ep2_outland_11's doors_biground_1, the doors that shut the silo's west tunnel): a drum of concrete and steel 224 wide, cut at 192 over its floor (Valve's drum runs on to 448); its lower 160 two leaves hinged at the inside (x 28, y -79 and 79) that swing 60 degrees outward at 6 a second (10 s), a lock bar in the floor (doorlock_biground_1: down 32 at 100) that opens first and shuts once the leaves are shut, and the sounds ep2_outland_11.blastdoors_open_start, _open_loop, _open_end and _close_end. Anchor: the floor at the middle of the drum's depth (1260 -9936 -320 in Valve's map); Valve's outside is -x. 15 brushes, all cut at the box (each cut face nodraw); wiring: the two leaves, the bar, two sounds and Valve's player clip (Valve's leaves are not solid to players). The bunker's main door (map_forest.py, BunkerForest.door).
